{{MultipleIssues|image|moresources}}
'''Metals''' were a type of solid material. The [[Rodian cryogen whip]] had an outer coating consisting of metal rungs. The [[energy buckler]] consisted of a metallic disk worn on the wielder's wrist.<ref name="Keeping the Peace">''[[Keeping the Peace]]''</ref>
